name_english: Rāja-Vidya Rāja-Guhya Yoga (Royal Knowledge and the Supreme Secret)
summary_short: Krishna reveals the most confidential knowledge: pure devotion, divine grace, and universal compassion.
summary_medium: Krishna explains the supreme secret of devotion, how He pervades and sustains all beings, why devotion transcends sin, and how sincere surrender brings peace regardless of one’s past.
summary_detailed: This knowledge is the most secret and purifying.
Krishna sustains all beings without attachment.
The world operates under divine law.
Devotion is accessible to all, without discrimination.
Even those who have erred can attain peace.
God protects what devotees lack and preserves what they have.
what_you_learn: Why devotion heals guilt and fear.
How God remains close even when unseen.
Why love is the highest path.
